observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (1269 x 1870) blurred 3x3, overview and two tiles with a 0.02 grid
covers: the cab's blue lamp seen square-on from below on the header's lower face, with the loom above it, the right visor's corner and hinge rod below, and the surface round it
notes: VEHICLE: the hangar session, the ex-NVA 9A33BM3-1 (g082-g096). The Rothmans-stickered visor at the bottom shows this is the right visor; the book says an emergency light is above the commander's sun shield, which is this lamp. It is g089-d d51 (x about 0.56, under the header right of centre behind the loom, its dome hidden in g089-d) and g087-d's blue arc at x 0.10-0.19, y 0.07-0.10 above the visor. It is mounted on the header's face below the loom, not on the roof.

details.what: the lamp: a large round blue glass dome with a clear central bulb area, a grey cage of a ring and four spokes across it, a wide cast aluminium-coloured bezel flange round it
details.size_cue: about five times as wide as the visor's ball pivot

details.what: screws round the lamp's flange, the two at the lower right and bottom with rust-red heads
a braided lead from the lamp's flange at its lower left down past the visor's pivot
the loom above the lamp: white cables, black braid and blue wires bundled across the frame, a white plastic band clip standing over the lamp's top, a stud clip on the blue wires
details.size_cue: white cable about the lamp's screw head, three times

details.what: a horizontal crease across the whole frame above the loom: the roof's front band meeting the header's face (the corner of the two)
the header's paint round the lamp: pale, off-white grey, a fine leathery grain and shallow wrinkles most marked at the right, like paint over a soft or sprayed layer
the visor's ball pivot and rod end, with the rod running right along the visor's top edge
the visor's left corner, rolled rim, rounded corner, a dark oval sticker
a pale rounded corner of a pressed bracket on the header's face at the right edge of the frame
